property_summary: For any successful non-reverting transfer call, the original contract always returns true; the mutant incorrectly returns false on success.
All recipients in _tos receive the transfer when _tos.length > 1.
When _tos.length > 1, at least the first recipient's transfer is attempted.
The transfer call never reverts when _tos.length > 1 and from != caddress.
When _tos.length > 1, from != caddress, and v == 0, the transfer call never reverts.
